verdict.rationale: Supabase ships a dashboard AI Assistant, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence only shows Supabase acting as an MCP server (hosted and local) and letting developers host their own MCP servers on Edge Functions. Neither is a server-side role or building block that lets Supabase plug in MCP servers and use their tools, and nothing shows the AI Assistant connecting to external MCP servers.
